description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop.

hooks.command: engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.12/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi
engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.12/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi

dir=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}
root=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$root" ] || { [ -d "$dir/.vendor/workflow-kit" ] && printf '%s\n' 'Workflow Kit not checked: git did not find the project repository (is git on PATH?). From the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit'; exit 0; }
for ref in '@{upstream}' origin/HEAD; do
base=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --verify -q --abbrev-ref "$ref" 2>/dev/null) || continue
git -C "$root" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "$base" 2>/dev/null || continue
n=$(git -C "$root" rev-list --count "HEAD..$base" 2>/dev/null)
[ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] || continue
[ -n "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --ignore-submodules 2>/dev/null)" ] || git -C "$root" -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null merge --ff-only --quiet "$base" >/dev/null 2>&1
break
done
set -- $(git -C "$root" ls-files -s -- .vendor/workflow-kit 2>/dev/null)
[ "$1" = 160000 ] || exit 0
pin=$2
kit="$root/.vendor/workflow-kit"
ok() { [ "$(git -C "$kit" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "$pin" ] && [ -f "$kit/AGENT_RULES.md" ]; }
ok && exit 0
if [ -e "$kit/.git" ] && { [ -n "$(git -C "$kit" status --porcelain --ignored --untracked-files=all 2>/dev/null)" ] || [ -n "$(git -C "$kit" rev-list -n 1 HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null)" ]; }; then printf '%s\n' 'Workflow Kit is not at the commit this project pins, but it has local changes or unpublished commits, so it was not updated: resolve them, then from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit'; exit 0; fi
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=true SSH_ASKPASS=true git -C "$root" -c credential.interactive=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null submodule update --init --checkout .vendor/workflow-kit >/dev/null 2>&1
ok || printf '%s\n' 'Workflow Kit missing, incomplete or not at the commit this project pins: from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit (still missing: git -C .vendor/workflow-kit checkout -- AGENT_RULES.md)'

dir=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}

for ref in '@{upstream}' origin/HEAD; do
base=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --verify -q --abbrev-ref "$ref" 2>/dev/null) || continue
git -C "$root" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "$base" 2>/dev/null || continue
n=$(git -C "$root" rev-list --count "HEAD..$base" 2>/dev/null)
[ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] || continue
[ -n "$(git -C "$root" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain --ignore-submodules 2>/dev/null)" ] || continue
base=$(printf %s "$base" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9/._-')
msg="Checkout is $n commit(s) behind $base (as of the last fetch) and has no commits of its own but local changes, so it was not fast-forwarded and its rules, skills and board commands may be outdated. Nothing was fetched: commit or stash the changes, run git fetch, then git merge --ff-only $base; skills load at session start, so restart after updating."
printf '%s\n' "$msg"
exit 0
done
exit 0
